text_en: O give thanks to the Lord , call on his name, make known his deeds among the peoples.
text_cn: 请众感谢上主，呼号他的圣名， 请众在万民中，宣扬他的功行。

text_en: Sing to him, sing praises to him; tell of all his wonderful works.
text_cn: 请众歌颂他，咏赞他， 传述他的奇工妙化。

text_en: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice.
text_cn: 请你们以他的圣名为光荣， 愿寻求上主的人，乐满心中。

text_en: Seek the Lord and his strength; seek his presence continually.
text_cn: 请众寻求上主和他的德能， 要时常不断追求他的仪容。

text_en: Remember the wonderful works he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he has uttered,
text_cn: 请你们记念他所行的奇迹， 他的异事和他口中的判词。

text_en: O offspring of his servant Abraham, children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
text_cn: 天主的仆人亚巴郎的后裔， 上主拣选的雅各伯的儿子！

text_en: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
text_cn: 他是上主，是我们的天主， 他的统治遍及普世各处。

text_en: He is mindful of his covenant forever, of the word that he commanded, for a thousand generations,
text_cn: 他永远怀念着自己的盟约， 直到万代不忘自己的许诺；

text_en: the covenant that he made with Abraham, his sworn promise to Isaac,
text_cn: 就是向亚巴郎所立的盟约， 向依撒格所起的誓诺，

text_en: which he confirmed to Jacob as a statute, to Israel as an everlasting covenant,
text_cn: 为雅各伯立为不移的规条， 向以色列立为永远的盟约，

text_en: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan as your portion for an inheritance. ”
text_cn: 说：我必将客纳罕地赐给你， 作你们产业的一分子。

text_en: When they were few in number, of little account, and strangers in it,
text_cn: 当他们在那地侨居时， 寥寥无几而人数极稀，

text_en: wandering from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people,
text_cn: 从这一族系迁徙到另一族系， 从这一国家飘流到另一地域。

text_en: he allowed no one to oppress them; he rebuked kings on their account,
text_cn: 他不但不让人把他们压迫， 且为了他们还把众王责斥，

text_en: saying, “Do not touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm. ”
text_cn: 说：“你们决不可触犯我的受傅者， 你们切不可把我的先知伤害！”

text_en: When he summoned famine against the land, and broke every staff of bread,
text_cn: 以后他使饥荒笼罩那地， 断绝了食粮的任何供给。

text_en: he had sent a man ahead of them, Joseph, who was sold as a slave.
text_cn: 在他们以前他将一人遣去， 就是那被出卖为奴隶的若瑟。

text_en: His feet were hurt with fetters, his neck was put in a collar of iron;
text_cn: 人以铐镣紧扣他的双脚， 他的颈项也带上了铁锁，

text_en: until what he had said came to pass, the word of the Lord kept testing him.
text_cn: 直到他所讲的那预言实现， 上主的话才在他身上应验。

text_en: The king sent and released him; the ruler of the peoples set him free.
text_cn: 君王遂派人释放了他， 众民的首长解救了他。

text_en: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his possessions,
text_cn: 且立他为皇家的宰相， 掌管一切皇产的侯王，

text_en: to instruct his officials at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
text_cn: 让他随意指导通国的王侯， 以其智谋教训通国的长老。

text_en: Then Israel came to Egypt; Jacob lived as an alien in the land of Ham.
text_cn: 从此以色列进入了埃及， 雅各伯也就在含邦作客。

text_en: And the Lord made his people very fruitful, and made them stronger than their foes,
text_cn: 上主使他的百姓昌旺， 比他们的仇敌更强壮。

text_en: whose hearts he then turned to hate his people, to deal craftily with his servants.
text_cn: 他转变他们的心，仇恨他的百姓， 让他们阴险残酷对待他的仆人。

text_en: He sent his servant Moses, and Aaron whom he had chosen.
text_cn: 他打发他的仆人梅瑟和所拣选的亚郎，

text_en: They performed his signs among them, and miracles in the land of Ham.
text_cn: 叫二人对他们将奇迹和异事行于含邦。

text_en: He sent darkness, and made the land dark; they rebelled against his words.
text_cn: 上主命降黑暗。立时天昏地暗， 然而埃及人却反抗他的圣言。

text_en: He turned their waters into blood, and caused their fish to die.
text_cn: 他使他们的水都变成血， 将他们的鱼类全部杀灭。

text_en: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the chambers of their kings.
text_cn: 虾蟆在他们的土内蕃生， 跳进了他们众王的内宫。

text_en: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, and gnats throughout their country.
text_cn: 他一发命，苍蝇便成群飞来， 蚊蚋（ruì）也在他们的各地徘徊，

text_en: He gave them hail for rain, and lightning that flashed through their land.
text_cn: 代替时雨，为他们降下冰雹， 在他们全国各地雷电闪烁，

text_en: He struck their vines and fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
text_cn: 打坏了他们的葡萄和无花果树， 又击倒了他们国内的一切树木。

text_en: He spoke, and the locusts came, and young locusts without number;
text_cn: 他一发命令蝗虫飞遍， 蚱蜢的数目，无法计算，

text_en: they devoured all the vegetation in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.
text_cn: 吃光他们地里所有的青草， 吞尽他们田间所有的百果。

text_en: He struck down all the firstborn in their land, the first issue of all their strength.
text_cn: 他打击境内所有的头胎，将强壮的长子全部杀害。

text_en: Then he brought Israel out with silver and gold, and there was no one among their tribes who stumbled.
text_cn: 他领出满携金银的以色列， 全支派中没有一个人残缺。

text_en: Egypt was glad when they departed, for dread of them had fallen upon it.
text_cn: 以色列出走，埃及人无不欢愉，因为那实在叫他们战兢恐惧。

text_en: He spread a cloud for a covering, and fire to give light by night.
text_cn: 他展布云彩，用以掩护遮阴， 他竖立火柱，为在夜间照明。

text_en: They asked, and he brought quails, and gave them food from heaven in abundance.
text_cn: 他们一恳求，他就送来鹌鹑， 用天降的食粮，饱饫了他们。

text_en: He opened the rock, and water gushed out; it flowed through the desert like a river.
text_cn: 他辟开了岩石，使水涌出， 在沙漠中好像江河流注。

text_en: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham, his servant.
text_cn: 因为他没有把他神圣的许诺遗忘， 并且也常怀念着他的仆人亚巴郎。

text_en: So he brought his people out with joy, his chosen ones with singing.
text_cn: 他引百姓欢乐地离去， 他率领选民欣然出走。

text_en: He gave them the lands of the nations, and they took possession of the wealth of the peoples,
text_cn: 给他们划分了异民的领土，使他们占领了外人的财富，

text_en: that they might keep his statutes and observe his laws. Praise the Lord !
text_cn: 为叫他们遵行他的诫命， 恪守他的命令。 亚肋路亚。
